original_source: Dashboards in Focus not filtering by goals correctly
symptoms: Focus dashboards displayed unfiltered goal data
Incorrect filtering results shown to users
failure_pattern: A bug in the filtering logic of the Focus dashboard service caused the system to ignore goal filters, resulting in dashboards displaying all goals regardless of the selected focus area.
mitigation_principle: Add unit tests for filtering logic; add integration tests for dashboard queries; enforce code review for filtering changes; monitor dashboard query results for anomalies

original_source: New goal links in dashboards have display chart error
failure_pattern: A recent change adding new goal links to dashboards introduced a bug that caused the chart rendering component to fail, resulting in display chart errors for users.
mitigation_principle: Implement comprehensive unit tests for chart rendering; enforce code reviews for UI changes; add automated UI regression tests; monitor chart rendering errors in production; use canary deployments for UI updates

original_source: Jira Align integration is currently down for some customers in the APAC and EMEA regions.
symptoms: Jira Align data missing in Focus
integration unavailable for APAC and EMEA customers
failure_pattern: The Jira Align integration connector failed to retrieve or display data for customers in APAC and EMEA, causing missing Jira Align information in Focus. The issue was identified and a fix was implemented, restoring data visibility for all sites.
mitigation_principle: Implement health checks for third‑party integrations; add retry logic with exponential backoff; monitor integration metrics and set alerts for missing data; maintain graceful degradation fallback; document and test integration failure scenarios.

original_source: Unlinking work items from Focus areas broken
symptoms: unable to unlink work items from Focus areas
operation failures for Jira issues and Atlassian Projects/Goals
failure_pattern: A bug in the unlinking logic prevented work items from being disassociated from Focus areas, causing the unlink operation to fail for all affected items.
mitigation_principle: Implement comprehensive unit tests for unlinking functionality; add integration tests covering all product integrations; enforce code review for changes affecting unlinking logic; monitor unlink operation metrics; add fallback or retry logic

original_source: Jira Align Themes and Capabilities are not appearing for some EU Focus users
symptoms: Themes and Capabilities not displayed in Jira Align for EU Focus users
failure_pattern: A configuration error in the Jira Align integration caused the Themes and Capabilities feature to fail to load for EU Focus users, resulting in missing UI elements.
mitigation_principle: Implement region-aware configuration validation; add automated UI regression tests for feature visibility; monitor feature flag rollout and fallback UI; perform configuration drift detection

symptoms: support portal displaying temporary channel message
customers unable to create support tickets
failure_pattern: An outage in AWS infrastructure caused disruption of Atlassian cloud services, leading to widespread service outages, inability to create support tickets, and backlog of event processing, while Atlassian teams monitored and coordinated with AWS to restore functionality.
mitigation_principle: Implement multi-cloud redundancy; add health checks and automated failover; monitor third-party provider status; maintain incident response playbooks; enforce SLAs with providers; use circuit breakers; perform regular disaster recovery drills
